posts.caption:
Stop jumping rope like this. Both feet, big jump, pause on every landing.

It's more pounding on your knees, less speed, and you gas out fast.

Skip it like a boxer. One foot at a time, low and quick, like running in place. In this clip I'm at about 155 steps a minute.

Save this for your next cardio day and send it to the guy at your gym who jumps like a kangaroo.

#over40 #jumprope #fitnessover40 #homeworkout #fatloss

6 weeks of crunches. Zero belly fat lost. 7 ab exercises, 5 days a week.

Ab endurance went up. Belly fat didn't change compared with the group that skipped ab work. Vispute et al., Journal of Strength and Conditioning Research, 2011.

At 38 I was 200 lb doing hundreds of crunches. I saw none of them.

Abs are a body-fat number, not a rep count.

Save this for the next time someone tells you to do 100 crunches a day.

#over40 #sixpackabs #fatloss #abworkout #fitnessover40

3 moves. 3 minutes. No gym. 1 minute on each move.

Spiderman plank: knee to the same side elbow, keep your hips level, alternate sides.

Toe touch crunch: legs straight up, reach for your shoes, and lower slowly.

Plank up-down: forearms to hands one arm at a time, hips square, and switch your lead arm.

Screenshot this, do it tonight, and tag the friend who says he has no time.

#homeworkout #abworkout #over40 #fitnessover40 #sixpackabs

posts.caption:
Stop doing towel rows like this. Hold the towel loose and you're just waving your arms.
That's why so many guys think towel rows are a scam.
Pull the towel apart hard before you row. Stay tense the entire set.
My boy Mike Chang used to karate chop people's towels. If yours collapses, pull harder.
Save this for your next home workout. Send it to the guy who says towel rows are a scam.
#over40 #homeworkout #formcheck #fitnessover40 #sixpackabs

Stop deadlifting like this. A rounded back is the biggest reason I see guys get hurt.
Look at the ceiling, or the sky if you're outside. When you're looking up, you can't really have bad posture.
Bend your legs, not your back. Use it most when you're tired. That's when posture slips.
Save this for your next leg day. Send it to the guy who deadlifts staring at his shoes.
#over40 #formcheck #kettlebell #fitnessover40 #homeworkout

Stop doing side laterals like this. If your elbow isn't high, your delt isn't really being worked.
Lead with your elbows, not your hands, and stop at shoulder height.
Tilt the dumbbells like you're dumping out two jugs of water. Then lower slow.
Go light, 5 or 10 pounds. No rocking.
Save this for your next shoulder day. Send it to the guy whose side laterals look like a chicken dance.
#over40 #shoulders #formcheck #fitnessover40 #homeworkout

Stop doing V-sit twists like this. If you just move the ball, you're not really working as much.
Balance on your butt, knees up. Move your legs to one side and bounce the ball there, then switch.
The ball is just a counterweight.
Do them after toe touches so your obliques take over.
Save this for your next ab day. Send it to the guy who does V-sit twists like he's passing the salt.
#over40 #abworkout #sixpackabs #formcheck #fitnessover40

3 ab moves. 10 reps each. 3 rounds. Jog in place 30 seconds between rounds.
Toe touches. Lie flat, arms overhead, and jackknife up. Picture kneeing yourself in the face.
V-sit twists. Balance on your butt, legs to one side, bounce the ball on the other.
Spiderman planks. Elbows up to a push-up position and back down.
New? Do 1 round. Start with no weight. I use a 4 lb ball.
Save this for your next ab day.
#over40 #abworkout #sixpackabs #homeworkout #fitnessover40

posts.caption:
3 moves. 90 seconds. Every commercial break, and you're back before the game comes back.
Push-ups for 30 seconds. Chest all the way down. Too hard? Do them from your knees.
Squats for 30 seconds. Sit back like there's a chair behind you, then stand up tall.
Plank for 30 seconds. Squeeze your abs, no butt in the air.
That's 30 minutes by the end of the game. Comment how many breaks you made.
#over40 #homeworkout #fatloss #fitnessover40 #sixpackabs

Stop curling like this. If you have to swing your body to move the weight, it's too heavy.
Most common curl mistake I see. If you're swinging like this, you're not really working your biceps.
Stand straight up and down. Curl with the bicep only, then go right back. No rocking, no momentum.
Save this for your next arm day. Send it to the guy who curls with his whole body.
#over40 #armworkout #formcheck #fitnessover40 #biceps

Your metabolism didn't crash at 30. Or at 40. 6,421 people measured. From 20 to 60, no change.
Pontzer et al., Science, 2021. After 60 it drops 0.7% a year.
At 38 I was about 200 lb. Same metabolism. Abs at 40.
Age isn't the problem. Your life is. Lift 3 days a week, protein every meal, track calories.
Save this for the next time someone tells you your metabolism is shot.
#over40 #metabolism #fatloss #fitnessover40 #sixpackabs

3 moves. 5 minutes. No gym. 30 seconds on, 30 seconds rest, until 5 minutes are up.
Squats. Sit back like there's a chair behind you.
Push-ups, chest all the way down. Too hard? From your knees.
Spiderman planks. From your elbows up to a push-up position, one side then the other, and back down.
5 minutes every day beats an hour once a week. Save this and do it tomorrow morning.
#over40 #homeworkout #noequipment #fitnessover40 #sixpackabs

Stop kettlebell deadlifting like this. Bell out in front, you end up bending over to reach it.
Most guys are doing these wrong. Bell between your feet, slightly wider than your shoulders, toes forward.
Squat down with a straight back, grab it, stand up.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Save this for your next home workout. Send it to the guy who picks up a kettlebell like a dropped phone.
#over40 #kettlebell #formcheck #fitnessover40 #homeworkout

Carbs at night make you fat? This group lost more. Most of their carbs at dinner, 6 months.
Sofer et al., Obesity, 2011. 78 obese police officers. Against a standard weight loss diet, they lost more weight, waist and body fat, and they were less hungry.
Timing isn't the problem. The total is.
So move your carbs to dinner.
Save this for the next time someone tells you no carbs after 6 PM.
#over40 #fatloss #carbs #fitnessover40 #nutrition

$17 ab wheel. 3 levels. Pick yours. 3 sets, 1 rep left in the tank.
Level 1, kneel and roll out a few inches. Arms locked, back flat.
Level 2, about halfway. Pull back with your abs, not your arms.
Level 3, nose as close to the ground as you can. Don't let your lower back sag.
Add an inch or two each workout. Which level are you on? Comment 1, 2 or 3.
#over40 #abwheel #abworkout #sixpackabs #fitnessover40

Protein per 100 calories. Shrimp gives you 24 grams for every 100 calories you eat.
Tuna in water is 22. Egg whites 21. Chicken breast 19. 0% Greek yogurt and 1% cottage cheese, 17 each.
Whole eggs are only 9. And peanut butter is 4. It's a fat with a little protein, not a protein food.
These are approximate, from USDA data.
Save this, and comment which protein you eat most.
#over40 #protein #fatloss #nutrition #fitnessover40

2 dumbbells. 6 minutes. Bigger arms. 30 seconds a move, 30 seconds rest. I do 3 rounds.
Bicep curls. Bicep only, no swinging.
Side lateral raises. Go light, most guys need 5 or 10 lb. Elbows high at the top.
Overhead tricep extensions. Elbows tucked in tight, dumbbell a few inches back from your neck.
One round before the pool, three for a full workout. Tag the friend who never trains triceps.
#over40 #armworkout #dumbbellworkout #homeworkout #fitnessover40

Lower abs won't show? Do these 2, every day, at the end of your workout.
Reverse crunches. Knees bent, curl your hips off the floor toward your chest, and lower slowly.
Toe touches. Legs straight up, reach for your toes, shoulder blades off the floor. Squeeze at the top.
These build the muscle. Your diet burns the fat on top of it.
Send this to a friend whose lower abs won't show.
#over40 #lowerabs #abworkout #sixpackabs #fitnessover40

Wide shoulders. Small waist. 2 moves. Your shoulders get wider while your waist gets smaller.
Side lateral raises. Light dumbbells, slight bend in your elbows, up to shoulder height and no higher.
1 warm-up set of 12 to 15, then 2 sets of 6 to 10.
Stomach vacuum. Breathe all the way out, pull your belly button in toward your spine, hold 20 seconds. Every morning.
Comment: which one do you skip?
#over40 #vtaper #shoulders #fitnessover40 #sixpackabs
